bestBets.overview: Lacklustre 1600m maiden to kick off proceedings. Not a whole lot of speed to report up front here. WIZARDS STAR is the horse to beat off ratings, did enough last time out at Hawkesbury in a nice enough race, peaks fitness-wise and should get every chance. LEON RUBEN is the danger, been up a while but did put in a solid last-start effort. FLYING ARABESQUE maps ideally here coming off back-to-back encouraging efforts at this track, up to 1600m now is ideal. MY CARTOUCHE rounds out the numbers with the smart use of the claim.

raceTips.comment: Emirate Star was posted wide on debut then was finishing off well before being tightened for room last time out. Fitter again, the rise in distance suits and this looks easier on paper. Stay Quiet was good once clear last start suggesting a rise in distance will suit. Blinkers going on can also spark further improvement. Wizard's Star is hard-fit and not unsuited coming back in distance. Recent form lines read well relative to this. Leon Ruben next.

bestBets.overview: Good 1000m contest with plenty of speed up front. Keen to see the covers come off the 5yo debutant LUCSAIN, she's trialled up exceptionally well on two occasions now, both in extremely fast time. She looks an out-and-out 1000m horse who is very well placed. No jockey booked just yet but we hope to see her line up Saturday. I liked the recent trial of RHYTHM OF THE REIN, he wanted to open his mouth and lay in a touch, slight query but from gate 3 he looks well placed on debut. The locally trained SILVERWATER KID is another who has impressed at the trials, will roll forward and give a good sight. CHATAIGNE rounds out the numbers, sticky gate but a kind starting point.

raceTips.comment: Lady Talea strips fitter third up and comes via solid maiden form races. Adding merit to her last start effort as she was posted wide throughout. Lucsain has been heavily supported for her debut though no jockey has been booked so not sure she'll run. If she does, her trials have been solid and that market support should be respected. Rhythm Of Rein has won a local trial leading in and moved well during said heat. Extreme Courage has trialled soundly but has the wide draw to overcome.

He looks a completely different horse this prep and a leading contender again. PHILATEC looks ready to peak third up after running strongly into the placings last start. Fitter now and the rise to 1500m looks ideal. ICEFORD is intriguing, having just one Australian start before being sent to the paddock. Returns after 21 weeks and has been trialling well, expecting a strong first-up effort. SAVOONGA has returned a much better horse this prep and can continue progressing after a strong last-start win.

raceTips.comment: Savoonga was drawing clear through the line when she knocked off her maiden last time out which not only suggests she will appreciate the rise in distance, but that she can measure up in this better company. She sets up for a soft run as an added bonus. Iceford has been trialling well leading into what will be his second Australian prep. Gets good weight relief with a claimer on. Orange Tsunami justified short odds to win over this trip last time out and will have fans on that effort. Philatelic is ready to peak and has been well supported to break a long winning drought.

bestBets.overview: SOUTHERLY BUSTER looks a leading contender in this field, with his last two runs giving plenty of confidence having him on top. Drawn a tricky gate, but he has a great turn of foot and with clear running late can be hitting the line strongly. BELLEVUE has a strong record over this trip and finds another suitable race to be a genuine chance. He will roll forward and should be at peak fitness now. NATURAL RULER is tough to get a read on, having shown glimpses in Victoria before crossing the border and dropping in trip. If he can regain his best form, he can be competitive. DARN CUTE will look to lead and give them something to catch.

raceTips.comment: Darn Cute appeals at the price. She will strip fitter from the run, claims again and will race on speed. Natural Ruler looks well placed coming back in distance and grade, though has big weight to lump. She didn't go a yard on the heavy when resuming so happy to forgive the effort. Southerly Buster is hard-fit and in form. No knock. Bellevue was good when only finding one better last night and will have fans on that effort.

When questioned re tactics, rdr reported he had been instructed to settle near midfield with cover, or if this was not achievable, it was an option to be forward. He said after beginning well and observing that the runners to his inside were not persisting forward, he allowed his mnt to stride forward and settle outside the leader rather than risk being caught wide without cover. When questioned re race tempo, rdr stated whilst he acknowledged the tempo was moderate, he felt it afforded his mnt a comfortable rhythm.
